text: {"assertions":["A crash loop issue was discovered in infra/k8s/deployment.yaml on 2026-02-23.","The crash loop only appeared after a rolling restart of the fleet was performed.","The root cause was schema drift between the database migration and the model definition.","The symptom was containers restarting within seconds of startup.","The issue prevented 40 duplicate rows per day from being written to the database.","The fix involved regenerating the model from the migration and pinning the checksum.","The fix was implemented in PR #1221 on the fix/crash-loop-1 branch.","The problematic code was located in the same part of deployment.yaml as previously addressed crash loop issues."]}
